stages.name: M4 MPS correctness and speed probe
stages.entry_condition: Stage22 source and ZIP hashes verified; GPU availability checked outside sandbox
stages.decision: Use MPS for B/C only if fixed acceptance passes and full single-image official flow is faster than CPU

stages.name: One frozen RISE-inspired candidate
stages.entry_condition: A passes; candidate probe and paired official9 candidate/8x8 estimate including probe <= 10800 seconds
stages.decision: No full CPU fallback run if A fails; no second candidate or repeat seeds

stages.name: Extra five original public images
stages.entry_condition: Original labeled JPEG dataset located or legally obtained; five names frozen before scores; same-device methods viable
stages.decision: Stop at completed pairs within budget; no five-image mean until all five pairs complete

stages.name: Archive, verify and report
stages.entry_condition: A/B/C results or explicit budget/availability stop reasons saved
stages.decision: Package output_mac_stage23.zip with manifest and CRC/SHA checks
